item.title: Workiva Platform Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 8:48 AM UTC to 09:12 AM UTC Workiva experienced an issue impacting the service across our production environments. However, if you continue to experience issues, submit a ticket to our Workiva Support Team, call 1-800-706-6526, or contact one of our international toll-free numbers.
